newsitem.title: UK: Powergen gain after planned share buy back.
newsitem.headline: Powergen gain after planned share buy back.

text.p: Shares in PowerGen Plc gained in early trading on Thursday after saying it planned a buy back of up to 10 percent of its equity and reporting first-half pre-tax profits in line with expectations.
The UK electricity generator's shares rose 7p to 557-1/2p by 0811 GMT.
"The fact that a share buyback is planned is positive but equally the fact that there's no definite timescale may be seen as disappointing," said one analyst.
First-half pretax profits were 138 million stg, excluding an exceptional credit of 69 million stg following the company's sale of a 21 percent stake in Midlands Electricity.
Analysts' forecasts were in a range of 124 million stg to 151 million.
"We are committed to deliver sustained shareholder value by balancing immediate returns through a share buy back programme," said chairman Ed Wallis in a statement.
